children: The UK retailer, founded by Mike Ashley, said it would keep buying shares to secure a majority position in Hugo Boss.
Frasers added that it is reviewing its support for Hugo Boss supervisory board chairman Stephan Sturm, signalling potential governance changes as it moves toward greater control.
Reporting by Frank Prenesti for Sharecast.com
